predecessors.name: Linear Pottery culture
predecessors.text: the middle Danube (5000 BCE) and the northern extension (4500 BCE)

successors.name: Funnelbeaker culture
successors.text: central Poland (Kuyavia, Greater Poland) from 4100 BCE; Bohemia, already drawn by the Funnelbeaker from 4100 BCE, at the 4000 BCE end

ledger.x: 5000 BCE: the painted-pottery Lengyel culture succeeds the LBK on the middle Danube.
4500 BCE: the northern extent, Bohemia (phase IV, the "Jordanow/Jordansmühler culture") and central Poland (Osłonki), enters the Lengyel after the Stroked Pottery culture.
4100 BCE: the Funnelbeaker culture takes central Poland (Kuyavia, Greater Poland).
4000 BCE: the Lengyel ends with phase IV.

certainty.note: An archaeological culture drawn by modern units: every edge is soft.
